Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a specialized isobaric labeling strategy (iqPIR) for quantitative cross-linking (XL-MS). While it is isobaric in nature, it does not fit standard TMT/iTRAQ categories as it uses custom peptide-based cross-linkers with 13C/15N labels. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of tandem MS for fragment ion quantification and the mention of 'precursor ion' selection.

scope: The quantitative performance of the 6-plex iqPIR strategy is evaluated using defined mixtures of purified proteins

We evaluated the quantitative performance of the 6-plex iqPIR on a set of five purified proteins, including alcohol dehydrogenase (ADH1_YEAST) from S. cerevisiae, albumin (ALBU_BOVIN) from B. taurus, cytochrome C (CYC_BOVIN) from B. taurus, hemoglobin (HMG_HUMAN) from H. sapiens, and myoglobin (MYG_HORSE) from E. ferus.
